raw_text: The supplementary NRC exclusion list published by the Assam government has sparked massive protests across Barak Valley. Over 15,000 Bengali-speaking residents have been affected by the latest round of exclusions. Civil society groups allege the process is biased against linguistic minorities. District administration has imposed Section 144 in Silchar and Karimganj.
